description.en: Geralt travels the roads of the Continent between familiar events, one quiet contract and human choice at a time.
description.zh: 傑洛特行走於大陸的道路，在熟悉事件之間，一次次面對不起眼的委託與人的選擇。
description.zhHans: 杰洛特行走于大陆的道路，在熟悉事件之间，一次次面对不起眼的委托与人的选择。

chapters.excerpt: A wet road, a tired witcher, and one village that is far too quiet.
chapters.recap: Geralt has been riding south beneath three days of cold rain, looking for little more than a dry stable, a hot meal, and a few hours without trouble.
chapters.ending: Some roads end at an inn. Others begin there.

paragraphs.en: The rain had followed Geralt for three days. It was thin rather than violent, the sort that slipped through leather one patient drop at a time and made even silence feel damp.
paragraphs.zh: 這場雨已經跟了傑洛特三天。它並不猛烈，而是細細密密，一滴一滴有耐心地滲過皮革，濕得彷彿連沉默都帶著水氣。

paragraphs.en: “Don’t look at me like that,” Geralt told Roach. “I didn’t summon it.”
paragraphs.zh: 「別那樣看我。」傑洛特對蘿蔔說，「又不是我把雨叫來的。」

paragraphs.en: Roach flicked one ear backward. Geralt chose to interpret this as criticism, mostly because there was no one else nearby to provide any.
paragraphs.zh: 蘿蔔把一隻耳朵往後撇了撇。傑洛特決定把這理解成責備，主要是因為附近實在沒有別人能負責這件事。

paragraphs.en: Near dusk, a village appeared between dripping birches. No smoke rose from its chimneys. No dogs barked at the road. Geralt slowed the mare before he had consciously decided to.
paragraphs.zh: 接近黃昏時，一座村子從滴著水的白樺林間浮現。煙囪沒有冒煙，路邊也沒有狗吠。傑洛特甚至還沒真正做出決定，便已讓母馬慢下腳步。

paragraphs.en: “There,” he murmured. “That’s the sort of quiet that usually costs money.”
paragraphs.zh: 「就是那裡。」他低聲說，「這種安靜通常都很花錢。」
